---
title: "prepDNAm QC report"
params:
  run_dir: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_setup.R", local = TRUE)
samples <- prepDNAm::qc_table_samples(rd)
batches <- prepDNAm::qc_table_batches(rd)
probes <- prepDNAm::qc_table_probes(rd)
n_removed <- sum(samples$removed)
merged <- rd$has[["beta_merged"]]
```

<div class="row">
<div class="col-md-4"><div class="stat">
<div class="value">`r nrow(samples) - n_removed` / `r nrow(samples)`</div><div class="label">samples retained</div>
</div></div>
<div class="col-md-4"><div class="stat">
<div class="value">`r if (merged) format(rd$info$n_probes_retained, big.mark = ",") else "&ndash;"`</div><div class="label">probes retained`r if (merged) sprintf(" (%s removed)", format(rd$info$n_probes_removed, big.mark = ",")) else " (run not merged yet)"`</div>
</div></div>
<div class="col-md-4"><div class="stat">
<div class="value">`r nrow(batches)`</div><div class="label">batch(es), by `r cfg$batch`</div>
</div></div>
</div>

## Run

```{r}
created <- as.POSIXct(cfg$created, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
details <- data.frame(
  setting = c("Run name", "Date", "Time", "Array", "Input type", "Batching", "prepDNAm version"),
  value = c(cfg$run_name, format(created, "%Y-%m-%d"), format(created, "%H:%M %Z"), rd$array$label,
            cfg$input_type, cfg$batch, cfg$prepDNAm_version))
knitr::kable(details, col.names = NULL, table.attr = "class=\"table table-condensed\" style=\"width:auto\"", format = "html")
```

```{r, results="asis"}
failed <- list.files(run_dir, pattern = "^FAILED_.*\\.txt$")
if (length(failed) > 0) cat("<div class=\"alert alert-danger\">**Failed stage(s):** ", paste(failed, collapse = ", "), " &mdash; see the files in the run directory.</div>\n")
if (!merged) cat("<div class=\"alert alert-warning\">The run has not been merged yet; pages that need `beta_merged` show placeholders.</div>\n")
sex <- prepDNAm::qc_table_sex(rd, sex_col = opts$sex_col)
if (!is.null(sex) && any(sex$sex_mismatch)) cat(sprintf("<div class=\"alert alert-warning\">**%d sample(s) with a sex mismatch** between reported and predicted sex &mdash; see page 5.</div>\n", sum(sex$sex_mismatch)))
```

## Batches

```{r}
b <- batches
b$pass_rate <- round(100 * b$pass_rate, 1)
names(b) <- c("batch", "samples", "removed", "retained", "pass rate (%)", "excluded", "low intensity", "failed probes")
DT::datatable(b, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 100)) |>
  DT::formatStyle("pass rate (%)", backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(c(80, 95), c("#f8d7da", "#fff3cd", "#d4edda")))
```

## Removed samples

```{r, results="asis"}
if (n_removed == 0) note("No samples were removed.")
```

```{r}
if (n_removed > 0) {
  rmv <- samples[samples$removed, intersect(c("basename", "batch", "reasons", "mMed", "uMed", "frac_failed_probes"), names(samples))]
  qc_table(rmv, round_cols = c("mMed", "uMed"), page = 10) |> DT::formatSignif("frac_failed_probes", 2)
}
```

## Probes

```{r, results="asis"}
if (is.null(probes)) note("Probe removal is recorded at the merge stage.")
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(probes)) {
  p <- probes
  p$description <- c(chrY = "chrY (and chr0/chrM on EPIC v2)", snp = "overlapping SNPs", non_cpg = "non-CpG probes",
                     zhou = "cross-reactive / unreliable (Zhou et al. 2017)",
                     detP = sprintf("failed (detP > %s) in > %s of samples", cfg$detp_threshold, cfg$failed_sample_threshold),
                     na_fraction = sprintf("missing in > %s of samples", cfg$probe_na_threshold),
                     not_in_all_batches = "not present in every batch", unique = "distinct probes removed")[p$reason]
  DT::datatable(p, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 100))
}
```

## Pages

1. **Samples** &mdash; per-sample QC metrics, removals and reasons.
2. **Controls** &mdash; Illumina control probe intensities (IDAT input).
3. **Intensities** &mdash; median intensities, failed-probe fractions and signal-to-noise (rho).
4. **Beta densities** &mdash; raw, Noob and BMIQ distributions.
5. **Identity & biology** &mdash; sex check, genotype agreement, immune cells, age, marker CpGs.
6. **Dimensionality reduction** &mdash; PCA / UMAP and batch-effect screen.
7. **Run details** &mdash; configuration, thresholds, versions, stage timings.
